# Darwesh Group — website

This repository serves [www.darweshgroup.com](https://www.darweshgroup.com)
through GitHub Pages.

It contains **build output only**. Every file here is generated from the
Darwesh Group private source repository and pushed automatically on each
release. There is no source code, no build tooling and no project history
in this repository.

**Do not edit files here.** Changes made in this repository are overwritten
by the next publish, and they do not exist in the real source. Website
changes are made in the private repository.
